title: 08 Artboard Kinds
subtitle: Fixed size (App, Social), web page, print and video artboards — Alligators brand
brief: artboard kinds print/web/digital/video atd. — a visual size picker grouped by what you're making (App · Web page · Social · Print · Video) over four kinds (Fixed size · Web page · Print · Video), web pages that grow and duplicate at other widths, fixed-size social with safe zones, print in mm with bleed/trim/safe-margin guides, video with a timeline, and the edge cases of a real mixed canvas (Alligators Combine-kampan: 21 artboards, 19 fixed size + 2 print; LetakA6: 4 print artboards).

sections.subtitle: F over empty canvas opens the size picker: App, Web page, Social, Print, Video. The tile you pick sets the kind.

artboards.label: 1 · F — pick what you're making
artboards.note: F over empty canvas opens a tile picker above the toolbar; the tile sets the kind; a dashed outline shows where it lands. With an artboard selected F draws a frame; F + drag skips the picker.

artboards.label: 2 · All sizes, the four kinds, a custom print size
artboards.note: Three common sizes per group, All N opens the rest; badges say Fixed size / grows / mm with bleed / timeline; the legend says once that App and Social are both Fixed size.

artboards.label: 3 · A web page grows with its content
artboards.note: A web artboard stacks content and its height fits it — adding a section makes the page longer; Fixed height is one switch away.

artboards.label: 4 · Duplicate at another width
artboards.note: Desktop, Tablet and Mobile side by side; Mobile reflows longest; the too-wide strip shows as a label mark + an inspector row.

artboards.label: 5 · Matchday post and story
artboards.note: Fixed-size artboards keep exact px with freely placed content; the story shows Instagram's safe zones.

artboards.label: 6 · Safe zones, close up
artboards.note: Story, Reels and profile-grid crops drawn on the artboard and never exported — replacing Alligators' hand-made check artboard.

artboards.label: 7 · A6 flyer — the inspector speaks mm
artboards.note: Paper, mm size, orientation, bleed, safe margin, guides and a plain colour line (RGB — the print shop converts to CMYK).

artboards.label: 8 · Print guides from View, next to the web page
artboards.note: Menu › View › Advanced › Print guides (ticked) shows bleed, trim and margin on all four flyers; the web version sits beside them.

artboards.label: 9 · A video artboard summons the timeline
artboards.note: Selecting a video artboard brings 07's compact timeline, sliding out of its bottom edge; the length is on the label; the inspector is the shared video row set.

artboards.label: 10 · ⌘0 fits all 21; Layers filters by kind
artboards.note: The real Combine-kampan at fit: 19 fixed size + 2 print sheets; the Print chip in Layers dims everything else.

artboards.label: 11 · Canvases filtered by kind, across 93
artboards.note: The same chips filter the Canvases panel; each hit shows its folder and how many artboards match.

artboards.label: 12 · Two kinds selected
artboards.note: With a fixed-size post and a print sheet selected, the inspector keeps only what they share.

artboards.label: 13 · Post 4:5 → A6 print
artboards.note: Changing kind asks first: what converts, where the extra height goes, what to check; the A6 is made from a copy.

artboards.label: 14 · After — the post stays, the A6 copy sits beside it
artboards.note: The signature moment, drawn to scale at 40 %: the untouched post beside its A6 copy (about 40 % of its width) with Ink fill, bleed and margin, and the two checks at the top of the inspector.

artboards.label: 15 · Warnings — one place, one verb
artboards.note: Crosses the cut, longer than one export (2 min / 3600 frames), 1 px off the paper size — each a label mark + an inspector row with one verb.

artboards.label: 16 · Advanced — exact values and the code
artboards.note: Exact px and mm, resolution (300 dpi print PDF is a v2 default), the colour note (RGB — the print shop converts to CMYK), column guides, Look and layout (as 06 · ad-inspector) and the artboard as code.

artboards.label: 17 · About the next two
artboards.note: Explains that the next two artboards are real canvas-lib artboards, not drawings.

artboards.label: 18 · A · přední (FLAG) — real print artboard
artboards.note: A real kind="print" artboard with print={{ paper: "a6", bleedMm: 3 }} at the resolved 419 × 581 px.

artboards.label: 19 · Nábor FLAG — real web artboard (hug)
artboards.note: A real kind="web" artboard at 834 px without fixed — its height grows with the page.
